note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-24): 10 pictures from 20 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper half to 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God is not pictured; the ark, the flood and the animals are shown as the text's own images, and Noah and his family only through ordinary people of today. Nothing violent is shown: the violence and the deaths are shown by their aftermath and by silence. Genesis 6's pictures (pairs standing in a meadow, the ark with a lit door under a storm) were not repeated.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

scenes.principle: Go into the ark, you and all your household, for it is you I have seen to be righteous before me in this generation.
scenes.shows: A family of eight, parents with three grown sons and their wives, walk up the ramp into the ark together, seen from behind.
scenes.prompt: Seen from behind, a family of eight ordinary people of today in plain everyday clothes, an older grey-haired couple, their three grown sons and the sons' wives, walk together up a long wooden ramp toward the big open door in the dark pitch-coated wooden side of the ark, carrying small bundles. Warm lamplight glows inside the door. Grey overcast sky. The family and the open door are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Of all the clean beasts you are to take seven of each, and of the birds of the sky seven of each, to keep offspring alive on the face of the whole earth. For in seven more days I am going to make it rain.
scenes.shows: Sheep with newborn lambs and pairs of white doves in a sunny meadow, while far on the horizon a long line of dark cloud is gathering.
scenes.prompt: In a sunny green meadow a small flock of sheep grazes, ewes with newborn lambs beside them and a ram among them, while pairs of white doves sit on a wooden fence. Far away on the horizon a long line of dark cloud is gathering. The sheep, lambs and doves are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Two by two they came to Noah into the ark, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
scenes.shows: Pairs of animals walk two by two up a wide wooden ramp into the open door of the ark, pairs of birds flying in above.
scenes.prompt: Pairs of animals walk two by two up a wide wooden ramp into the big open door in the dark pitch-coated side of the ark: two elephants, two giraffes, two lions, two zebras, two sheep, two by two in a long line, with pairs of birds flying in above them. Cloudy sky. The ramp, the line of animals and the open door are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: All the springs of the great deep burst open, and the windows of the sky were opened. And the rain was on the earth for forty days and forty nights.
scenes.shows: Water bursts up out of great cracks in the ground in roaring fountains while torrents of rain pour down from a black sky.
scenes.prompt: On a wide plain, water bursts up out of great cracks in the ground in roaring white fountains, while torrents of rain pour down from a black sky. The fountains, the falling rain and the black sky fill the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: On that very day Noah went into the ark, and all the wild animals, the livestock, every creeping thing and all the birds, every bird of every wing.
scenes.shows: Inside the ark by lamplight, a long deck of stalls with pairs of animals settled in, birds in pairs perched on the beams overhead.
scenes.prompt: Inside the great wooden ark, lit by warm hanging lamps: a long deck of wooden stalls with straw, where pairs of animals have settled in, two lions, two horses, two goats, two deer, two oxen, while pairs of birds of every kind perch side by side on the heavy beams overhead. The stalls and the birds on the beams are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And those that came, came male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him. And Yahweh shut him in.
scenes.shows: The huge door in the side of the ark shut tight, rain streaming down it, warm light glowing at its edges.
scenes.prompt: Close view from outside of the huge wooden door in the side of the ark, now shut tight and sealed, rain streaming down its dark pitch-coated planks. A thin line of warm golden light glows around its edges. The empty wooden ramp below lies in the rain. The shut door is high in the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the waters increased and lifted the ark, and it rose up from the earth. And the ark went over the face of the waters.
scenes.shows: The ark afloat on wide brown floodwaters under heavy rain, the tops of trees just showing round it.
scenes.prompt: The ark, an enormous plain wooden vessel shaped like a long rectangular box, three decks high, its hull coated in black pitch, with a low pitched roof, a row of small openings for light just under the roof, and one large door in its side, floats on wide brown floodwaters under heavy grey rain, the tops of drowned trees just showing above the water around it. The floating ark is high in the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the waters prevailed very greatly on the earth, and all the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.
scenes.shows: The last tip of a snowy mountain peak still showing above a boundless grey sea.
scenes.prompt: A boundless grey sea under a heavy grey sky, rain falling. Only the very last tip of a snowy mountain peak still shows above the water, small waves washing at its rocks. The peak is in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And all flesh that moved on the earth breathed its last. Everything that had the breath of the spirit of life in its nostrils died.
scenes.shows: A wide still flood sea under a grey sky, the bare tops of a drowned forest standing silent above the water, not a bird anywhere.
scenes.prompt: A wide, still flood sea under a pale grey sky in total silence. The bare, leafless tops of a drowned forest stand above the flat water, mirrored in it. No bird, no animal, no movement anywhere. The drowned treetops are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And he wiped away every being that was on the face of the ground. And only Noah was left, and those with him in the ark.
scenes.shows: The ark alone on a calm boundless sea under a vast sky, a thin warm light in its windows.
scenes.prompt: The ark, an enormous plain wooden vessel shaped like a long rectangular box, three decks high, its hull coated in black pitch, with a low pitched roof, a row of small openings for light just under the roof, and one large door in its side, floats alone on a calm, boundless sea that reaches to the horizon on every side, under a vast pale sky with breaking clouds. A thin warm light glows in its small windows. Nothing else is anywhere on the water. The ark is in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.
